name: How do I care for my new flooring after installation?

mainEntity.name: How do I care for my new flooring after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Care instructions vary by flooring type. For hardwood, use a pH-neutral cleaner and avoid excessive moisture; sweep or vacuum regularly. Laminate and LVP require similar cleaning, but are more water-resistant; avoid abrasive cleaners. Tile floors are generally low maintenance, needing regular sweeping and mopping with a suitable cleaner, but grout may need periodic sealing. Always follow the manufacturer's specific care guidelines for your chosen material to ensure longevity and maintain its appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Care depends on flooring type: hardwood needs pH-neutral cleaners and minimal moisture; laminate/LVP are water-resistant but avoid abrasives; tile requires regular cleaning.
